text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! What an unexpected turn of 
events...! Unbelievable! Un-be-lievable!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio is defeated! Her dream of the 
Triple Crown ends here—!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo is totally satisfied! Full throttle 
all the way! *puff out chest*

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What was with the way things went 
today...? It's totally different from what 
I expected...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Still, surely this is what a GⅠ is... This 
is what the Classic Triple Crown means. 
Maybe I was completely misunderstanding 
things...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Trainer, Trainer! Turbo had so 
much fun!
choice_data_list: I see. That's great to hear!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! But... I didn't win, and I feel like 
I didn't stand out much, did I?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From a trainer's perspective... the impact 
of running in that race was immense.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo, unpredictable in how she'd 
run, was without a doubt the eye of the 
storm. Without her, the outcome would have 
been completely different.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just one unexpected element can 
drastically change the outcome. That's 
racing.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Turbo's gonna try even harder 
next time!
choice_data_list: Yeah! Let's make sure to train properly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whenever Twin Turbo enters a race from now 
on, it will undoubtedly turn into an 
unpredictable wonderland.
